The '''2021–22 Linafoot''' was the 61st season of the [[Linafoot]], the top-tier [[association football|football]] league in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], since its establishment in 1958.<ref>{{Cite web|title=LINAFOOT.com|url=https://linafoot.com/|access-date=2022-02-23|website=linafoot.com}}</ref> Following the long interruption between 9 March and 29 May 2022, due to the clubs transport difficulties, the second half of the season was canceled.

== Teams ==
Twenty teams are compete in this season: the top 16 teams from the previous season and four promoted teams from the [[Linafoot Ligue 2|2020–21 Linafoot Ligue 2]] – [[US Panda B52]], [[AS Kuya Sport]], [[Etoile de Kivu]], [[US Tshinkunku]]<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-09-15|title=Résultats Linafoot Vodacom Ligue 1 (2021–2022)|url=https://footrdc.com/resultats-linafoot-vodacom-ligue-1-2021-2022/|access-date=2022-02-23|website=Foot RDC|language=fr-FR}}</ref>{{citation needed|date=April 2025}}
